summary: NEMA 17 stepper motor on a custom adapter plate, bolted to an L bracket
assumptions: Motor envelope 42.3 x 42.3 x 48 with a Ø22 pilot boss 2 mm proud and a Ø5 shaft 24 long (NEMA 17 frame).
The adapter plate stands on the bracket foot against the upright; four M4 screws into tapped holes in the upright.

parts.name: Mounting bracket
parts.description: Aluminium L bracket: foot 80 x 60 x 6 mm, upright 80 x 14 x 70 mm at the back edge, four M4 tapped holes (12 deep) in the upright on a 60 x 40 mm pattern, a Ø52 window in the upright on the motor axis for the motor screw heads, two Ø6.6 fixing holes in the foot.

parts.name: Motor adapter plate
parts.description: Custom aluminium adapter plate 80 x 60 x 5 mm: Ø23 pilot bore, four Ø3.4 holes on the 31 mm NEMA 17 square, four Ø4.5 holes on a 60 x 40 mm pattern for the bracket.

parts.name: Stepper motor NEMA 17
parts.description: Bought-out NEMA 17 stepper motor, modelled as its envelope: body 42.3 x 42.3 x 48, Ø22 pilot boss, four M3 tapped holes 8 deep on the 31 mm square in the face (check the motor's datasheet), Ø5 shaft.

parts.name: Motor screw M3x12
parts.description: ISO 4762 socket head cap screw M3 x 12 through the adapter plate into the motor face.

parts.name: Plate screw M4x16
parts.description: ISO 4762 socket head cap screw M4 x 16 through the adapter plate into the bracket upright.
